summary: Toggle a relationship status (such as following, subscribing, saving, joining, pinning, or blocking) for a specific user, post, tag, or item.
preconditions: The target item, post, user profile, or conversation is visible on the screen or has been navigated to.
steps: Locate the interactive element (button, icon, or link) associated with the relationship action (e.g., 'Follow', 'Save', 'Join', 'Subscribe', 'Star', 'Pin', 'Block').
Click the element to toggle the relationship state.
If a confirmation dialog or form submission is triggered, confirm or submit the action.

variants.when: the action is tag-specific or item-specific on a feed
variants.do: Click the specific toggle button directly on the feed card (e.g., 'Subscribe #tag' or 'Star').

variants.when: the action requires navigating to a detail page first
variants.do: Click the item or user link to open their detail page, then locate and click the relationship toggle button (e.g., 'Save Post', 'Favorite', 'Join Group').

watch_for: The button text or icon changes to reflect the new state (e.g., 'Follow' becomes 'Following', 'Save' becomes 'Saved', or an icon fills/highlights).
A temporary toast notification or confirmation message appears confirming the action.
completion_signal: The toggle control displays the requested final state (e.g., 'Following', 'Unsubscribe', 'Pinned', or a filled star/heart icon).
pitfalls: Clicking the toggle button twice, which reverts the relationship back to its original state.
Clicking a toggle on the wrong item when multiple similar items are displayed on the page.
